decisions.reason: As a flagship reference electrometer close to the firm's core dosimetry competence and accredited calibration business, it meets aspirations in a growing industry, so the expanding firm has no shortfall to prompt problemistic search and keeps it.

The oncology risk management software builds on the firm's software integration capabilities and supports its strategy of converging machine and patient QA, so although its results are still uncertain, slack from the firm's growth lets it carry the product rather than drop it after one year.
